authoredNote: Lines computed from `nl -ba` of the committed fixture; the positive rows pin BOTH metadata.owner and metadata.ownerEvidence, and the negative row pins the ABSENT case (`meta.owner: null`) so an over-claim fails just as loudly as a miss.
rationale: PINS THE DESTRUCTURED-FROM-TYPED-SOURCE CLASS: `const { worker } = cfg` with `cfg: Settings` makes the binding a `Worker` — the member's declared type — and the evidence class is `destructured` (the type was inferred from a VALUE, not from an annotation on the pattern). The negative row is a destructuring from a value with NO stated type (`cfg as any`): the row exists but must carry NO owner (`meta.owner: null`), so over-claim fails too.
